threshold.label: Minimum threshold
threshold.description: Minimum proportion of non-null values required. If actual completeness is lower, an issue is generated.

columns.label: Columns

threshold.label: Uniqueness threshold
threshold.description: Minimum proportion of unique rows required. 1.0 = no duplicates allowed.

columns.label: Key columns
columns.description: Columns whose combination must be unique (e.g., identifiers). Empty = full rows.

method.label: Detection method
method.description: IQR is robust against asymmetric distributions. Z-Score assumes normal distribution and is more sensitive to extremes.

factor.label: Sensitivity factor
factor.description: Tolerance multiplier. Lower = stricter (more outliers detected). 1.5 is standard; 3.0 is permissive.

columns.label: Numeric columns
columns.description: Numeric columns to analyze. Empty = all detected numeric columns.

auto_detect_types.label: Auto-detection
auto_detect_types.description: Detects common formats (email, phone, date…) without manual configuration. If disabled, only 'columns' rules are evaluated.

threshold.label: Conformance threshold
threshold.description: Minimum percentage of values that must comply with the format in each analyzed column.

columns.label: Format rules
columns.description: List of columns with their expected type (email, phone_es, date_iso, dni_es, url…). Complements or replaces auto-detection.

auto_detect.label: Auto-detection
auto_detect.description: Automatically detects categorical columns based on the cardinality threshold.

columns.label: Columns to analyze
columns.description: Specific categorical columns. Empty = all auto-detected.

max_cardinality.label: Maximum cardinality
max_cardinality.description: Maximum number of unique values to consider a column as categorical. Columns with more values will be ignored.

imbalance_threshold_high.label: Dominance threshold
imbalance_threshold_high.description: Maximum percentage a class can occupy. Exceeding it generates an imbalance issue.

imbalance_threshold_low.label: Minority threshold
imbalance_threshold_low.description: Minimum percentage any class must have. Below this = underrepresented.

auto_detect.label: Auto-detection
auto_detect.description: Automatically detects date, timestamp, or datetime type columns.

columns.label: Date columns
columns.description: Specific date columns. Empty = all auto-detected.

staleness_threshold_days.label: Staleness threshold
staleness_threshold_days.description: Days without update after which a record is considered outdated.

rules.label: Business rules
rules.description: List of rules that data must comply with. 'violation': expression selecting invalid rows. 'if_then': if condition is met, assertion must be true.

descriptions.completeness: Detects columns with null or missing values. A complete dataset ensures AI models do not receive empty inputs that distort training or inference.
descriptions.uniqueness: Identifies completely duplicated rows. Duplicates bias statistical distributions and can artificially inflate the representation of certain patterns in the model.
descriptions.outliers: Detects values that deviate abnormally from the rest in numeric columns. Unmanaged outliers can degrade scale-sensitive models and distort statistical metrics.
descriptions.currentness: Measures the temporal obsolescence of records. Training with stale data assumes a static world and causes Data Drift: the model learns patterns that no longer represent operational reality.
descriptions.logical_consistency: Verifies that data complies with explicitly defined business rules. Detects contradictions and invalid relationships between columns undetectable by statistical metrics.
descriptions.class_balance: Detects imbalances in categorical columns where one class dominates. Severe imbalance in the target variable leads to classification models biased toward the majority class.
descriptions.syntactic_accuracy: Verifies that values comply with the expected format (emails, phones, IDs, dates, URLs…). Incorrect formats in key columns generate pipeline errors and worsen feature quality.

paramHints.completeness: threshold: minimum completeness (0–1). columns: empty = all.
paramHints.uniqueness: threshold: minimum row uniqueness (1.0 = no duplicates). columns: columns that must be unique.
paramHints.syntactic_accuracy: auto_detect_types: detect formats automatically. columns: column→format rules. Types: email, phone_es, phone_intl, date_iso, date_eu, dni_es, postal_code_es, integer, decimal, url, uuid, ip_v4, credit_card.
paramHints.class_balance: auto_detect: detect categorical columns. max_cardinality: max unique values to consider categorical. imbalance_threshold_high/low: imbalance thresholds.
paramHints.currentness: auto_detect: detect date columns. staleness_threshold_days: days without update = alert.
paramHints.logical_consistency: rules: list of rules. Type "if_then": condition + assertion. Type "violation": expression (rows that violate the rule).

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.description: Detects columns with null or missing values. Analyzes all dataset columns and alerts when the proportion of missing data exceeds the configured threshold.
completeness.thresholdHelp: An alert will be issued if overall completeness falls below this threshold.

uniqueness.title: Uniqueness
uniqueness.description: Detects fully duplicated rows in the dataset. Also identifies columns with low variability (e.g., a column that always has the same value).
uniqueness.thresholdHelp: 1.0 = no duplicates allowed. 0.95 = allows up to 5% duplicates.
uniqueness.columnsLabel: Columns that must be fully unique (e.g., IDs)
uniqueness.columnsEmpty: Empty = global detection applied to the full dataset

syntacticAccuracy.title: Syntactic accuracy
syntacticAccuracy.description: Verifies that column values comply with an expected format: valid emails, phone numbers, dates, IDs, postal codes, etc.
syntacticAccuracy.autoDetectCaption: Analyzes each column's content and automatically identifies emails, phones, dates, IDs and more.
syntacticAccuracy.thresholdHelp: If less than X% of a column's values comply with the expected format, an alert is generated.
syntacticAccuracy.advancedCaption: Specify the expected format for specific columns, complementing auto-detection.

classBalance.title: Class balance
classBalance.description: Detects when a category dominates data disproportionately. For example: a 'Status' field where 98% of records are 'Active' may indicate a quality problem.
classBalance.autoDetectCaption: Analyzes all columns with few unique values (text, boolean, codes).
classBalance.thresholdHighLabel: Alert if a class exceeds % of data
classBalance.thresholdHighHelp: A class representing more than X% of the total is considered dominant.
classBalance.thresholdLowLabel: Alert if a class represents less than % of data
classBalance.thresholdLowHelp: A class with less than X% presence is considered underrepresented.
classBalance.maxCardinalityTitle: Maximum unique values to consider categorical

currentness.title: Data currentness
currentness.description: Detects if date columns contain outdated data. For example: if the latest recorded date is older than expected, it may indicate data is not being updated correctly.
currentness.autoDetectCaption: Identifies columns with dates (timestamp, date, datetime) without manual specification.
currentness.stalenessCaption: If the most recent value of a date column is older than this time, an alert will be generated.
currentness.columnsEmpty: Empty = all date columns are detected and checked automatically

logicalConsistency.title: Logical consistency
logicalConsistency.description: Verifies that data complies with business rules you define. You can detect contradictions such as "end date before start date", "required field empty when active", or any domain-specific condition.
logicalConsistency.templatesHint: Add predefined rules with one click and customize them below
logicalConsistency.noRulesAlert: No rules yet. Use the templates above to add rules quickly, or create a custom one with "Add rule".

ruleTemplates.noNegativeHint: Detects values less than zero. Replace "my_column" with your column name.
ruleTemplates.requiredHint: Detects records where the field is empty (NaN != NaN is true). Replace "my_column" with your column name.

ruleTemplates.dateOrderHint: The end date must be after the start date.
ruleTemplates.activeRequiredHint: If status is "active", the indicated field must be filled (field == field is false for NaN).
ruleTemplates.qtyPriceHint: If there is a quantity, a price must exist.
ruleTemplates.paidAmountHint: If status is "paid", the amount must be greater than zero.
